name: Problem Solving Quiz 1
description: Find the correct formula to solve multi-step shopping and capacity/remainder word problems

name: Problem Solving Quiz 2
description: Slightly harder two-step shopping and capacity/remainder word problems with more varied scenarios

name: Problem Solving Quiz 3
description: Simple word problems on fractions, decimals, and percentages — find the correct formula

name: Problem Solving Quiz 4: Fractions & Percentages
description: Fraction, percentage, and algebra word problems — find the smart single-step formula, or the correct equation for "find the original" problems

name: Problem Solving Quiz 5: Harder Fractions & Percentages
description: Harder multi-item word problems — one item priced as a fraction/percentage more or less than another, combined totals, multi-item bundles, and backward equations

name: Problem Solving Quiz 6: Speed, Distance & Time (Foundations)
description: Basic speed, distance, and time word problems — find the correct single-step formula, including converting minutes to a fraction of an hour

name: Problem Solving Quiz 7: Speed, Distance & Time (Multi-Step)
description: Harder speed, distance, and time word problems — two-stage journeys, average speed, meeting/catch-up problems, and backward equations

name: Math Quiz 1: Algebraic Equations
description: Simple mental-math algebra questions using Expanding Brackets and Clearing Fractions

name: Math Quiz 2: Fractions, Decimals & Percentages
description: Mental-math conversions between fractions, decimals, and percentages, plus multiplying whole numbers by them

name: Math Quiz 3: Algebraic Equations
description: Harder algebra questions where the variable appears on both sides of the equation, including fractions with the variable in the numerator

name: Math Quiz 4: Number Sense
description: Use a known multiplication or division fact to work out a related fact by doubling, halving, or scaling by 100 — includes decimal answers

name: Math Quiz 5: Time Differences
description: Work out the difference between two clock times — in minutes, as "X hours Y minutes", or as decimal hours

name: Math Quiz 6: Fraction Calculations
description: Mental-math fraction arithmetic — add, subtract, multiply, divide, mixed numbers, and fractions raised to a power

name: Math Quiz 7: Order of Operations (BODMAS)
description: Mental-math sense-checking of brackets and calculation sequence — spot how brackets change the answer and apply × ÷ before + −, left to right

name: Math Quiz 8: Number Sense — Formula Reasoning
description: Given a known multiplication or division fact, pick the formula that correctly derives a related fact via scaling, compensation, or decimal shifts — without recalculating from scratch

name: Math Quiz 9: Estimating Division
description: Roughly guess big-number ÷ big-number by rounding to friendly numbers or testing the options — 100-question bank, 20 picked per quiz

name: Prefix Quiz 1
description: Choose the correct prefix to make an antonym or complete a sentence — each prefix is used exactly once within its set of 6

name: Suffix Quiz 1
description: Choose the correct suffix to complete a sentence, or spot the word that cannot take a given suffix — each suffix is used exactly once within its set of 5
